name: rand_below
note: LCG random 0..n-1 (state 0x80079a34, x*0x41c64e6d+0x3039), taking the top bits for small n. Battle rolls use it.

name: rand_below_mod
note: LCG random 0..n-1 (same state as rand_below), plain modulo. Mostly the spell-effect animations.

name: battle_rng_state
note: State of rand_below/rand_below_mod.

name: battle_main
note: Battle state machine, called by main each frame; the phase is battle_phase (0x800796fa).

name: battle_phase
note: State of battle_main: 0 setup, 8 commands, 0x22 actions, 0x2a messages, 0x1c rewards/chest ...

name: battle_setup_groups
note: Random encounter: rolls group sizes, member levels and HP, follow-up groups, surprise and the friendly-monster chance.

name: battle_run_actions
note: Steps initiative ticks 0-10 and runs each combatant whose action record tick matches.

name: battle_special_action
note: Dispatches negative action codes: fight, dispel, hide, call for help, flee...

name: party_melee
note: A party member fights: target, hit threshold, swings, damage dice for both hands.

name: party_melee_tail
note: Second-weapon part of party_melee, split off by the decompiler (its MAIN callers are bogus).

name: pick_target_member
note: If the chosen target is down (status >= 0x80), picks the first standing one (party: front 3, or all 6 when the arg is 1).

name: melee_apply_hits
note: Applies a party weapon hand: verb, sleeping/hidden bonus, slaying x2, HP, weapon status effects, death.

name: act_dispel
note: Dispel: per monster 5*L+50-10*monster level (Bishop -26, Lord -18), only undead-flagged groups.

name: apply_status_effects
note: Rolls the seven hit effects (sleep, poison, stone, confuse, paralyze, knock out, decapitate) and level drain.

name: monster_melee
note: A monster attacks: picks one of its attacks (reach rules), hit threshold, third attack.

name: monster_attack_roll
note: Rolls one monster attack: swings, hits, damage dice; nouns >= 0x2ab turn into a spell/ability.

name: monster_hit_apply
note: Applies a monster attack: incapacitated bonus, protection halves, HP, effects, death.

name: act_monster_flee
note: Monster tries to flee: monster flag 0x400 and rand(100) < record +0x8a.

name: act_call_help
note: Monster calls for help: flag 0x800, fewer than 9 in group, rand(90) < record +0x8b.

name: cast_spell
note: Spell or ability: targets, spell points, silence, sealing roll, item use, then spell_dispatch.

name: battle_message_build
note: Turns an action's results into the FIGHTMSG lines shown in order.

name: weapon_reach
note: Furthest enemy group a weapon reaches from the attacker's row.

name: roll_dice
note: roll_dice(n, sides, bonus): n dice of 1..sides plus bonus, capped 0x7fff.

name: results_clear
note: Clears the per-action result lists before an action.

name: spell_dispatch
note: Calls spell_handlers[action_code].

name: pick_party_member_n
note: Nth standing party member; a hidden one is skipped 70% of the time.

name: battle_box_print
note: Expands one FIGHTMSG line into the battle box rows (text_expand with wrap on).

name: spell_damage_one
note: Damage spell on one target: n dice of 1..sides, through the damage core 0x800b0c6c.

name: spell_damage_group
note: Damage spell on each member of a group (party: a row); element resist halves the dice, weakness doubles.

name: spell_ac_change
note: Adds to the AC modifier (+4 of the combatant record) of one target or a group, clamped -99..99.

name: spell_group_range
note: For spells that sweep groups in a fixed battle, the last group to hit.

name: spell_flags
note: spell_flags_table[spell].

name: spell_flags_table
note: u16 per spell: 1 battle, 2 camp, 4 chest, 0x10 one party member, 0x20 one enemy, 0x40 one group, 0x100 damage, 0x200 buff, 0x400 status, 0x800 heal, 0x1000 cure, 0x8000 hostile (meanings inferred from the spells that carry them).

name: spell_handlers
note: Code pointer per spell index (0-20 Mage, 21-41 Priest, 42-62 Alchemist, 63-83 Psionic; STATUS.OBJ 222+).

name: combatants
note: Combatant records, 14 bytes; group g (0 party, 1-4 monsters, 7 extra) at +g*0x7e, member m at +m*0xe: +0 level, +2 silenced, +4 AC modifier, +6 HP, +8 swings, +9 initiative tick, +0xa action, +0xb target group, +0xc status.

name: battle_groups
note: 8 bytes per group g: +0 identified, +2 monster id, +4 count, +5 standing, +6 spell sealing level, +7 magic screen (Cortu).

name: initiative_tick
note: Current initiative tick, 0-10.

name: actor_group
note: Group of the combatant acting (0 party, 1-4 monsters, 7 extra).

name: actor_member
note: Member index of the combatant acting.

name: action_code
note: Action being run: 0-83 a spell, negative a command (-1 fight, -2 defend, -4 dispel, -7 ambush, -8 hide, -9 breath, -10 call help, -11 fight, -12, -20 flee).

name: target_group

name: target_member

name: hidden

name: surprise

name: friendly_encounter

name: groups_per_area

name: friendly_area

name: spell_damage_core
note: Applies spell or breath damage to one target: magic or breath resistance roll (resist% - Nofis fifths + 1), side damage bonus, HP, death, messages 129/150/151/186-188.

name: status_spell_targets
note: Loops a status spell over its targets and calls status_spell for each.

name: status_spell
note: Status spell on one target: resistance, then a save clamped 5..100 (rand(100) < save) with +4 per level the target is above the caster. Kinds 0 sleep, 1 silence, 2 death, 4 paralysis, 5 stone, 8 confusion.

name: spell_cure
note: Cures status bits on one ally (Latumofis and the like).

name: spell_heal
note: Heals dice HP up to max HP; messages 143/144, 163/164.

name: party_breath
note: A party member's breath (acid, 207/208): damage = current HP >> times breathed; the first breath above level 8 hits every group.

name: monster_breath
note: A monster's breath on one row: q + 2*rand(q), q = HP/4 (300-rand(120) above 300); halved by resist bits and a rand(20) save; then a side effect.

name: save_adjust
note: Adjusts a save value by the target's resist and weakness bits.

name: saving_throw
note: Returns true when rand(20) < the given save value.

name: breath_damage_cap
note: Caps party breath damage once it passes 50.

name: monster_target_random
note: Picks a random reachable party member for a monster (front row only without reach); hidden members skipped 70%.

name: monster_target_weakest
note: Picks the reachable party member with the least HP (AI column 1); a hidden one may be skipped for the next.

name: monster_pick_spell
note: Picks one of a monster's spells matching the AI column.

name: monster_ai
note: Each monster's action and initiative tick ((rand(255)&7)+2, +rand(3) for spells): confused 72% random attack, else a weighted column of the 0x800d89e0 row.

name: party_initiative
note: A party member's initiative tick (rand(10) adjusted by agility +0x17) and its command list (fight, ambush, hide, defend, spell, dispel).

name: party_commands
note: Battle phase 0x1c: the party's command input.

name: party_flee_roll
note: Party flee: chance 80 (+5*(P/M) if P >= M) - 2*area danger; success on rand(100)+1 < chance; fixed battles can't be fled (206).

name: battle_rewards
note: End of battle: drained and lost characters, then the EXP pool divided among members with status < 0x20 (198).

name: monster_killed
note: Kill bookkeeping: status 0x80, EXP to the pool, the killer's +0xc0 count.

name: count_survivors
note: Counts party members with status below 0x20.

name: remove_lost
note: Deletes characters with status 0x200 and records their names in lost_names.

name: exp_for_level
note: Minimum EXP for a level, race and class (used to reset a drained character's EXP).

name: party_wiped
note: Party wipe: bodies left at the square (return 2), or sent to town in the training maze (return 1); item loss; every member's gold halved.

name: wipe_item_loss
note: Destroys items on a wipe: rand(12) < 8 for ids 72-130, 199-240, 277-324, < 3 otherwise. Bug: reads members[actor_member] each pass (0x800c5c28), so only one character is rolled, six times.

name: battle_clear_tables
note: Clears the combatant and group tables before a battle.

name: monster_upkeep
note: Round start for monsters: recovery min(k*level,35)% (fear 3, sleep/KO 4, paralysis 2, stone 1), poison HP/8, regen +0x81, deaths, group compaction.

name: party_upkeep
note: Round start for the party: poison, regen +0x8b, deaths, sleep/KO recovery min(4L,35)% after round 1, fear min(3L,35)%, confusion counter -10.

name: counters_tick
note: Silence counters, magic screen decay (5-10 above 10, Fofic +10 for the party) and spell sealing decay.

name: party_row_swap
note: Swaps the rows when nobody in front can fight and somebody behind can.

name: identify_roll
note: Each able member may identify a random unknown group: chance level + stat +0x14 + stat +0x15 - 4 out of 99.

name: groups_reorder
note: Random encounters: a tougher group moves ahead of a weaker one (285).

name: chest_open
note: After a won battle: the chest, its trap roll and the chest menu (215-220).

name: chest_present
note: No chest in the training maze or fixed battles 0x91-0xab.

name: chest_trap_pick
note: Trapped with chance (danger-1)/18 when mask bit 0 is set, else always; trap picked evenly among mask bits 1-12.

name: chest_trap_effect
note: Runs the twelve chest traps (Stone Shot ... Teleporter).

name: spend_spell_point
note: Takes one spell point at the spell's school and level.

name: item_use_after
note: After an item's spell: potions/scrolls (subtype 0x14/0x15) use a charge; others break with chance item +0x0e into item +0x10.

name: monster_status_recover
note: Rolls one monster's recovery from a status.

name: summon_creatures
note: Socordi/Bamordi/Gardi/Zakaldi (arg 0-3): tier from caster level, rand(100) column 46/16/10/10/7/7/4%, creature from 0x800a1270/0x800a12b0 and records at 0x800d5f58; one summoned group at a time (189).

name: mahaman_wish
note: Mahaman's wish menu (FIGHTMSG 267-283); not decoded.

name: alchemist_cloud
note: Liqurea..Madalqua: puts a 3-round damage cloud (dice, element, message) in one of two slots on the target group (0x8008c418..).

name: psionic_damage
note: Sios/Lios/Masios/Lasios: dice damage, then confusion with chance p (status save 100-p), halved by resist bit 8, 80% if weak.

name: monster_ai_weights
note: AI rows by monster +0x88 (1-based), 13 percentage columns: fight, fight weakest, defend, damage 1, damage group, status, buff, heal, cure, call help, breath, breath weak row, flee.

name: area_danger
note: Danger level by area class (0-16): chest trap odds and trap damage.

name: flee_penalty
note: Flee penalty by area class (twice the value is taken off the chance).

name: exp_pool
note: Experience from monsters killed this battle (sum of +0x7c).

name: flee_result
note: Set when the party's flee succeeds.

name: cloud_damage
note: End of round (phase 0x24, slots 0 and 1): each group's Alchemist clouds do group damage, then count down.

name: chest_loot
note: Opened chest: gold = dice(+0x50) * u32(+0x54) * dice(+0x58) split among status<0x20 members (262); up to three items on rand(85) <= +8+4k (261).

name: fixed_battle_setup
note: Fixed-encounter group layout from tables 0x800d591c (ids 0x154+) and 0x800d5b68 (ids 0x17b+), 15 bytes a row.

name: summon_records
note: Monster records (0xd0 each) of the 36 summonable creatures, 9 per summon spell.

name: group_pick
note: The party's enemy-group pick (Fight 0x11, spell 0x34, item 0x54, Dispel 0x41, Ambush 0x71, Breath 0x91). One group and a last index of 0: takes group 1 at once, no screen. Random encounters: list_cursor, group = list cursor + 1. Fixed battles: group_pick_grid. Result in pick_result.

name: group_pick_grid
note: Fixed battles' 3x2 pick: moves (group_pick_grid_move), draws the frame, and on circle maps grid position col + 3*row + 1 to a group through grid_pos_entry / group_grid_entry. Arg 1 (group spells and items, Breath above level 8): picks a row, returning 1 (top) or 2 (bottom, only while both rows stand).

name: group_pick_grid_start
note: Grid pick start at each command: row 0; column 1 if top-middle holds a group, else 0, else 2.

name: group_pick_grid_move
note: Grid pick moves: left/right wrap within the row skipping empty cells; up/down flip the row, then look for a group from the column (up leftward, down rightward); no move if none. Fight flips rows only while short_reach_groups < cmd_reach.

name: list_cursor
note: Two-axis menu cursor: up/down move 0x80079b95 over 0..arg6, left/right 0x80079b8c over 0..arg5, both wrapping. Returns 1 circle, -1 cross, -2 nothing.

name: cmd_reach
note: weapon_reach of the member at the command list (party_initiative). Not set for a confused member, whose Fight pick then uses the previous member's reach.

name: pick_list_max
note: Last list index for Fight (min(cmd_reach, groups_standing) - 1), Dispel, Ambush, Breath (groups_standing - 1).

name: pick_col
note: Fixed-battle pick cursor column, 0-2.

name: pick_row
note: Fixed-battle pick cursor row, 0 top (front) 1 bottom.

name: pick_result
note: The group (or row) picked; party_commands copies it to the member's combatant +0xb.

name: pick_spell_flags
note: spell_flags & 0xff0 of the spell or item being aimed; 0x40 makes a fixed battle's pick take a row.

name: battle_menu_screen
note: party_commands state: 5 members, 9 commands, 0x11 Fight pick, 0x31 spell grid, 0x32 spell list, 0x33 member pick, 0x34 spell group pick, 0x41/0x51/0x54/0x71/0x91 Dispel/Use/item pick/Ambush/Breath, 0x20 Parry...

name: list_cursor_y
note: Vertical cursor of list_cursor: battle command row, spell school, spell list, random-encounter group pick (group - 1).

name: battle_fixed
note: 1 in a fixed battle (set by fixed_battle_setup): grid group pick, row-sweeping group spells.

name: groups_standing
note: Monster groups with a member standing (monster_upkeep); groups are kept contiguous from 1.

name: fixed_front_groups
note: Fixed battle: groups left in the front row (groups 1..n).

name: fixed_back_groups
note: Fixed battle: groups left in the back row (after the front ones).

name: short_reach_groups
note: Groups a short weapon reaches: 2 in random encounters, the front row's count in fixed battles (the back row's once the rows swap).

name: grid_pos_entry
note: Fixed battle: [1..6] the layout entry shown at grid position (1-3 top, 4-6 bottom), 0xff empty; the rows swap once when the front row falls.

name: group_grid_entry
note: Fixed battle: [1..6] each group's layout entry (0xff gone); moves with the groups when they close up.
